query: How do I reset my password?
response: To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. You'll receive an email with a secure reset link valid for 24 hours. Click the link and follow the on-screen instructions to choose a new password. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
context: Password reset requires email verification. The reset link is valid for 24 hours. If the email is not received, users should check their spam folder.

query: How do I cancel my subscription?
response: You can cancel your subscription at any time from the Account Settings page. Go to Settings → Subscription → Cancel Plan. Your access will remain active until the end of the current billing period. No cancellation fees apply.
context: Cancellation is available in Account Settings. Access continues until billing period end. No fees.

query: This is completely unacceptable service. I've been waiting three weeks for my refund!
response: I am deeply sorry for this unacceptable delay — a three-week wait for a refund is absolutely not the experience we want you to have. I am immediately escalating your case to our finance team with high-priority status. You will receive a direct call from a senior agent within the next 30 minutes to resolve this.
context: Refunds should be processed within 5–7 business days. Delays beyond 10 days require escalation to finance team.

query: Do you offer a free trial?
response: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card is required to start. Simply sign up on our website and your trial begins immediately.
context: 14-day free trial available. No credit card required. Full feature access during trial.
